prompts.name: viridian
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution background texture for a playable side-scrolling 2D Pokémon trainer fighting game. Wide 16:9 landscape, 1536x864 or larger. Polished Pokémon Let's Go / Pokémon Masters game art direction, clean cel shaded anime environment, precise fine architectural detail, crisp smooth outlines, lush rich colors, beautifully composed, NOT pixel art, no voxel blocks, not photographic. Camera at waist height across a fighting arena, level horizontal floor, moderate depth, background architecture above horizon at 65% image height, broad unobstructed floor in bottom 35%, fighters will be composited with feet at 86% image height. No people, no Pokémon creatures, no text, no UI, no watermark. Floor marked as a Pokémon battle court with elegant white court lines and a Poké Ball medallion at center foreground. Top 15% safe for UI overlay. Location: Giovanni's Viridian City Gym, Kanto. Emerald green and warm stone gym interior, high vaulted glass greenhouse roof, sunlight shafts, tall cream stone columns, elaborate carved earth badge on rear wall, terracotta and sage green walls, dense beautiful tropical ferns at both edges, green banners with simple earth badge symbols, heavy wooden double door center back. Refined patterned green-gray stone floor. Atmospheric golden late afternoon light, believable polished game environment, inviting nostalgia.
